name: dynrebind
description: THE BIND RECORD'S COMPARE AND REPATCH (shared libc SP5 spec 5.3, step 1 plan ruling R2).  No kernel path reclaims a library while a cached text bound to it exists, so the probe makes the mismatch itself: it corrupts the errno store in seterr() in its own shared code and a bank byte of its bind record, then execs itself.  The second run's binder must find the record stale, repatch every code site and write a new record; its errno check passes only if the site was repaired.  Control: treat the record as matching; the second run prints RBD FAIL.
